messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from Annexure to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 38):
"""
Loss ratio + Expense ratio; 4.33 Whether principle of uniform spread of risk is taken into consideration while arriving the refunds payable on cancellation/termination of policy. Please substantiate with relevant data or assumptions 4.34 Revision in pricing for existing products (Submit separately as an Annexure, percentage difference between existing and modified premium rates for each rating factor) 4.34.1 Whether there is an increase or decrease in the premiums Increase/Decrease/Increase in certain age groups only/Decrease in certain age groups only/NA 4.34.2 Justification for change/ modification in premium 4.34.3 Experience of the product across plans / sum insured / age bands In addition to the experience of similar products in Item 4.33, these tables to be furnished for the product for which revision in pricing is requested 4.34.4 How the pricing methodology differs between sum insured options 4.35 Results of Financial Projections/Sensitivity Analysis: [The profit margins should be shown for various model points for base, optimistic and pessimistic scenarios in a tabular format below.
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"What information must be provided when revising the pricing of an existing health insurance product?","answer":"The insurer must submit an annexure showing the percentage difference between existing and modified premium rates for each rating factor, indicate whether premiums increased or decreased overall or in specific age groups, provide justification for the change, present the product’s experience across plans, sum insured, and age bands, and explain how the pricing methodology differs between sum insured options.","facts":["\"percentage difference between existing and modified premium rates for each rating factor\"","\"Whether there is an increase or decrease in the premiums\"","\"Justification for change/ modification in premium\"","\"Experience of the product across plans / sum insured / age bands\""]},{"question":"What must be included in the financial projections or sensitivity analysis for a health insurance product revision?","answer":"The financial projections must show profit margins for various model points under base, optimistic, and pessimistic scenarios in a tabular format.","facts":["\"Results of Financial Projections/Sensitivity Analysis\"","\"The profit margins should be shown for various model points for base, optimistic and pessimistic scenarios in a tabular format\""]}]}
